title: Present Packing
description: Check if presents fit into delivery regions by capacity.
writeup:
## Approach

Each delivery region has dimensions `W x H` and a list of present counts. Each present requires a 3×3 area.

## Part 1

Compute the capacity of each region as `(W // 3) * (H // 3)` — the number of non-overlapping 3×3 slots. If the total number of presents fits within the capacity, the region is valid. Count valid regions.
